name: downpour-harness
description: The Downpour operating harness: the orient/prove/record loop, the stage gates, and the guardrail hooks that keep state/progress.json honest.

interface.shortDescription: Progress gates and the working loop for Downpour
interface.longDescription: Loads the five core Downpour skills (context-brief, progress-update, invariant-check, stage-gate, adr-new) and installs the guardrail hooks: a session brief on start, progress.json validation on edit, and a Stop gate that blocks a turn which changed source without recording it.
defaultPrompt: Give me the Downpour context brief.
Run the stage gate for the current stage.
Update progress.json for the work I just did.
